name: BOKU
notes: Low-volume site (~9 events within a 90d horizon). Server-rendered monthly list at /event/list/{year}/{month} gives id/title/category/teaser only; exact start/end/location come from each event's own .ics feed at /event/details/{id}.ics (TZID Europe/Vienna, no timezone conversion needed). Current-month list page mixes already-past days, so records are dropped if end (or start) is before today. price_min stays null unless description/teaser literally says gratis/frei/kostenlos; BOKU rarely states this so most records have price_min=null. district/city/address only fill for Vienna postal codes parsed out of the ICS LOCATION string (many BOKU events are off-site, e.g. Krems, Tulln, Raabs, or Online Event).
